dimensions.assessment: Affects institutions of higher education, State agencies or authorities offering education loans, and student borrowers.
dimensions.evidence: available only to a borrower who has been advised, such as in a financial aid offer, by an institution of higher education

dimensions.assessment: Changes disclosure requirements for specific state-based loans and requires a comprehensive GAO report on borrowing trends.
dimensions.evidence: provides that arrangements or agreements made under a state-based education loan program do not meet the definition of a preferred lender agreement

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not outline specific federal spending changes or direct appropriations for this bill.
Amends section 151 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 regarding preferred lender definitions and mandates a GAO report.
dimensions.evidence: Section 151 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1019) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment to the Higher Education Act alongside a one-time two-year reporting requirement for the GAO.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Comptroller General of the United States shall prepare and submit a report

missing_information: Exact fiscal costs or specific funding appropriations associated with the GAO study.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill creates an exclusion for certain State-based education loan programs from preferred lender arrangement disclosure requirements and mandates a Government Accountability Office report on student loan trends, affecting state agencies, higher education institutions, and student borrowers.
